messages:
mikey: dropping two row options for the autoscale table — 'condensed' (single-line steppers + small burst icon) and 'expanded' (two-line with inline cost + brief latency hint). screenshots: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/autoscale-rows (frames A1/A2) tess: skimmed both. condensed wins for dense lists, but burst icon reads like a badge not a control. suggestion: use a 16px thunder icon with an accessible label and a visible focus ring. copy idea: 'Short burst' vs 'Burst allowance' — prefer 'Short burst' for brevity. :bolt: ravi: engineering caveat — if burst opens a popover we need aria-haspopup and role=dialog for the panel. steppers should support left/right arrow increments (not just +/− buttons) so keyboard users can adjust quickly. also prefer debounced save at 750ms to avoid spamming the API on rapid key presses. jia: design note: add a very thin divider between steppers and burst so they feel distinct but still compact. for expanded view, show two micro-rows: rates (min/max) and below that a tiny line: "est. +$0.12 / min • est p95 +12ms" in muted text. for mobile, condensed must have 44px touch targets — current mock is 32px and will fail usability. olga: accessibility checklist: 1) burst button aria-label (include pool name), 2) aria-live region for value changes (polite), 3) ensure stepper contrast >= 4.5:1 for 12px labels, 4) focus order min → max → burst popover trigger, 5) tooltip content < 250 chars and keyboard-focusable. example snippet I'm recommending: ```html
Min: 1, Max: 8
``` mikey: thanks — I'll update the frames: add the thin divider, make burst icon-only with an explicit focus ring, and include the cost + latency microline in expanded. I'll also add a PR checklist item for touch target sizes and keyboard arrow support. aiming to push v3 by tomorrow morning.
